nationalGame.about: Pakistan's hockey wizards have won 3 Olympic gold medals and 4 World Cups.

loved.name: Cricket

fact: Tape-ball cricket — a tennis ball wrapped in tape — was invented on Pakistan's streets and is now played around the world.
